## Engineering reading {#engineering-reading}

Buffers generated text in StringIO and compares with existing file before write, preserving mtimes and avoiding recompiling all76 generated sources. An unreadable old file falls back to write; writes are not atomic. Exception inside context skips post-yield write. No regression tests added, and no build timing reproduced.

## Verification and boundaries {#verification-and-boundaries}

- Disposition: implementation/model/compiler.
- Reading method: Complete guarded message and meaningful first-parent diff text read. No unread meaningful changed-file content. Diff metadata formatting is not substantive evidence.
- All changed-file content accounted for; no binary changes, credential-redacted source lines or saved truncation in this retained slice.
- Source integrity independently checked against local Git objects. This check establishes content identity, not correctness.
- Runtime validation: none. No upstream compiler, build, tests, code generator, binary or oracle was executed.
- Changed-source context, relevant retained chronology and selected full-file/merge context reviewed. Referenced external dumps, restricted headers, decompilations, live captures, generated outputs and author test results were not independently reproduced; no complete surrounding-file read is implied.
